class.name: CubismModel2D
class.brief_description: Preferred resource-based Cubism runtime node, under development.
class.description: Owns one internal model runtime and its renderer. Assign an imported [CubismModelResource] to [member model]. The internal runtime is not saved as a scene child. The current API provides lifecycle, processing, and queued parameter control. The planned motion/controller and advanced rendering API is still being implemented. Parameter writes apply once on the next update, after physics and pose. Getters return evaluated values. Unload, reload, and tree exit discard pending writes. Use [method Node.queue_free] for deletion from signal callbacks.

method.name: load_model
method.description: Load a resource and return a Redot error code. A null resource clears the selection. Lifecycle signals are deferred.

method.name: unload_model
method.description: Dispose the runtime, retaining the public selection for an explicit reload.

method.name: reload_model
method.description: Reload the selected resource and discard pending writes.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advance only in manual playback mode while the node can process and is not paused.

members.member: Select native idle, physics, or manual playback. Does not replace inherited scene-tree process mode.
Suspend evaluation without consuming queued writes.
